messages: The finder looks at the whole photo and outlines the separate things in it: a bench, stairs, a railing. When the outlines show up, you click the one you want. If the thing you want is not outlined, press Mark it yourself and drag a box round it. It usually takes under a minute; the first one after a quiet spell can take a bit longer.
